rawContent: According to scientists, we have just 2 to 3 yrs to avoid a #climate catastrophe. Yet #women are in the minority when it comes to who’s negotiating a climate deal. I ask @BiancaPitt4 of @SheClimate how to boost their numbers. Watch the  @_51percent Fri 1445 GMT on @France24_en 🌏 https://t.co/e3iM8HwlYz

We have just two to three years to save our planet from a climate catastrophe.

It makes sense that all of us, #women and men, be present in equal numbers as talks continue on a global climate deal at @COP27P in Cairo next month.

#ClimateCrisis #Equality #RepresentationMatters
